one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent uninstalled the globally-installed pyknotid at step 22 to switch to an inplace build workflow, then verified all tests only via PYTHONPATH pointing to the source directory, never reinstalling to the global Python environment as required by the task.
t_err_evidence: Step 22: agent runs 'pip uninstall -y pyknotid' to resolve a perceived conflict, planning to use 'python setup.py build_ext --inplace' instead. At this point pyknotid had already been successfully installed globally with compiled .so files in step 16. The decision to uninstall without a plan to reinstall globally is the decisive mistake.
t_commit_evidence: Step 22 is both t_err and t_commit: once pyknotid is uninstalled, the agent pivots entirely to an inplace-build + PYTHONPATH verification strategy (steps 23-44), never issuing 'pip install .' again. All subsequent recovery work is scoped to the source tree, not the global environment.
trigger_explanation: The agent saw an ImportError in step 18 (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vispy') when running the test script from inside /app/pyknotid, which was picking up the local source tree rather than the globally installed package. The agent incorrectly concluded the issue was with the installed package itself rather than recognizing it was running from the wrong working directory. This false premise led it to uninstall the correctly-installed package.
